description: This file is the main program entry point for a backend API service built with ASP.NET Core. It configures services, middleware, endpoints, security, and API documentation (Swagger/NSwag). It includes endpoints for authentication, health checks, validation, asset management (create, read, update, delete, copy), lineage and status logs, and various asset-related child resources. It also sets up CORS, forwarded headers, idempotency middleware, and environment-based configurations.
